source: Society of St. Vincent de Paul USA (National Council)
finding: No public conference finder. ssvpusa.org's 'volunteer' page is a contact form (ZIP code field) that routes a person to a local council by e-mail; members.ssvpusa.org is the member portal; the only public locator is thriftstores.ssvpusa.org/store-locator (thrift stores = entities, not parish conferences). robots.txt: 'User-agent: *' Allow / with Content-Signal search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference (named AI-training bots disallowed). Conferences are parish-based, so the realistic path is diocesan/district council sites (e.g. svdp<city>.org 'find a conference' pages) one by one.
